title: Culture of SARS-CoV-2 in Vero E6 Cells
author: Alyssa Pyke
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcduis6w

steps.title: Prepare Vero E6 monolayers
steps.instruction: Move Vero E6 culture tubes from the 37 °C incubator into a Class II biosafety cabinet within a PC3 laboratory, discard the existing growth medium to waste, and retain the confluent, uninfected monolayer in Opti‑MEM (no FBS).

steps.title: Dilute and filter clinical samples
steps.instruction: Dilute each clinical sample in Opti‑Mem® reduced‑serum growth medium (no FBS) and filter the mixture through a 0.2 µm, 13 mm Acrodisc® filter (Bio‑Strategy Laboratory Products, Australia).

steps.title: Inoculate cells with sample
steps.instruction: Add 150–200 µL of the filtered patient material to each confluent Vero E6 monolayer; include a negative control tube receiving 150–200 µL of Opti‑Mem alone. Incubate the tubes for 1 hour at 37 °C to allow absorption, then feed each culture with 2 mL of pre‑warmed (37 °C) Opti‑Mem® reduced‑serum medium. Optionally, collect a 200 µL aliquot at this point as a Day 0 sample for later testing.

steps.title: Incubate and monitor for CPE
steps.instruction: Incubate the inoculated cultures for 2–7 days (typically at 37 °C) and observe daily for cytopathic effect (CPE). In samples with original RT‑PCR Ct ≈ 20, CPE may appear within 3 days post‑inoculation.

steps.title: Passage if no CPE observed
steps.instruction: If CPE is not detected in the first isolation attempt, transfer the cell‑culture supernatant onto fresh Vero E6 monolayers and repeat up to three additional passages, testing each passage as described in the confirmation step.

steps.title: Confirm virus replication by RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: For cultures showing CPE (damage, cell‑clearing, morphological changes), confirm SARS‑CoV‑2 presence using the Corman et al. E‑gene and the Northill et al. ORF1ab RT‑rPCR assays. Compare Ct values to those of the original clinical sample; cultured virus should yield lower Ct. If the first‑passage Ct is equal to or higher than the original sample Ct, investigate for possible low‑level replication or residual inoculum.
